##Handle Missing Values
```{r}
populations <- populations %>%
mutate(across(where(is.character)
~ ifelse(is.na(.), "Unknown", .)))

```
### Detect Outliers Using Boxplot

```{r}
numeric_cols <- populations %>%
select(where(is.numeric))
boxplot(
numeric_cols,
main = "Boxplot of Numeric Variables",
las = 2
)
```
##Remove Extreme Outlier
```{r}
remove_outliers <- function(x){
Q1 <- quantile(x,0.25)
Q3 <- quantile(x,0.75)
IQR <- Q3-Q1
x[x < (Q1-1.5*IQR)] <- NA
x[x > (Q3+1.5*IQR)] <- NA
return(x)
}
population_clean <- populations %>%
mutate(across(where(is.numeric),
remove_outliers))
```
```{r}
population_clean <- populations %>%
mutate(across(where(is.numeric), remove_outliers))
colSums(is.na(population_clean))
```
